channel.title: Vesper AI Radar
channel.description: Новые AI-инструменты и стартапы: что запустилось прямо сейчас — Show HN, GitHub, открытые запуски

item.title: Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the AI boom is ‘a great opportunity to go deceive people’
item.description: The cautionary Theranos tale takes on a new significance in the AI era, when companies that have never turned a profit are raising capital at trillion-dollar valuations.

item.title: N1nEmAn/sapper-v2
item.description: Autonomous pentest legion — AI commander + worker swarm + layered fact-intent graph. 3rd Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion (634 teams · 8h unattended · 1B tokens beat 4.5B). The Nüwa Test: give AIs Create/Language/History, let a civilization grow.

item.title: Skip the small talk: Make game-changing connections at TechCrunch Founder Summit with Braindate
item.description: At TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026, happening November 4 at SoWa Power Station in Boston, networking powered by Braindate is designed to make those conversations easier to find, whether they are in 1:1 or small-group on-site meetings. Register before the event starts to save up to $100 on your pass,

item.title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
item.description: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.

item.title: 5 days left: Your last chance to connect, scale, and save at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.description: 5 days to save up to $100, plus a second pass for free to TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 in Boston on November 4. Register now.

item.title: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
item.description: Runware is building a factory to turn out prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line. The real test will be whether it can deliver at that scale.

item.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
item.description: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

item.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
item.description: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

item.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
item.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

item.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
item.description: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

item.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
item.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

item.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
item.description: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

item.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
item.description: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

item.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
item.description: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

item.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
item.description: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

item.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
item.description: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

item.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
item.description: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.

item.title: wangzan101/Mika
item.description: Mika — 你手机上的私人 AI 助理，替你操作 App、上网、把事办成。An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.

item.title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
item.description: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

item.title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
item.description: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

item.title: unitshaperextol/Legion-os
item.description: Next-Gen Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestration Engine. Coordinate 50+ LLM nodes (GPT-6, Claude 5.5, DeepSeek-V4) in a high-speed mesh network. "Redefining enterprise AI infrastructure. The operating system for collective machine intelligence in the AGI era."

item.title: yc-software/minecraft-agent-harness
item.description: Run language-model agents in Minecraft with Mineflayer tools, persistent sessions and shell sandboxes.

item.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
item.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

item.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
item.description: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

item.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
item.description: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

item.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
item.description: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

item.title: w0ldan/exoproc
item.description: TypeScript toolkit for Windows x64 native systems programming, memory manipulation, and process instrumentation.

item.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
item.description: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

item.title: Wiz’s CTO on PHP2Shell and the coming ‘vulnpocalypse’
item.description: The PHP scare may have faded from your feed, but the cleanup is far from over. Last week, two critical bugs in the open source language behind roughly 70% of websites left organizations scrambling to fix their systems, with some taking sites offline until the vulnerabilities could be patched.
